headline: Rutschman goes deep as Sox burn rubber with five straight
morning_brew: Adley Rutschman absolutely electrified the Fens last night, drilling one over the Pesky Pole that had me jumping out of my seat like I was ten years old again. It was a damn beautiful sight to watch that ball sail into the right-field seats, giving us the breathing room we needed to put the Angels away. Brayan Bello was the real story, though, looking sharp as a tack while tossing five scoreless innings and giving us the stability we have been begging for all summer. When our starter holds the line like that and the bats wake up, it makes for a much smoother night in the Hub.

Winning five in a row in this league is no small feat, and you can practically taste the confidence radiating off this clubhouse right now. My mother, who knows more about pitch selection than half the analysts on TV, called me this morning to say the team finally looks like they trust each other to make the routine plays, which is a massive shift from the circus we were watching earlier this summer. We're sitting in a good spot for the wild card, and stringing together these quality wins is the only way to keep the pressure on the teams nipping at our heels. I'm not looking at the standings too closely because I don't wanna jinx it, but you can't ignore the way this group is cooking.

We keep the series moving this afternoon at the oldest yard in baseball, and I expect the boys to keep the intensity cranked up to eleven against Los Angeles. Sully called me a few minutes ago to blather on about playoff scenarios and I told him to put a cork in it, because we have way too much work left to do before we start packing bags for October. I'm just going to enjoy the ride and hope the momentum holds through the weekend, because this team is finally playing the kind of baseball that makes a townie like me feel like a genius for staying up past my bedtime.

trend_watch.trend: Crushed a three-run home run off the Pesky Pole to lead the offense in the win.
trend_watch.dans_take: That at-bat was pure adrenaline and exactly the kind of thump we need to break things open.

trend_watch.trend: Tossed five scoreless innings in his first start since early June to silence the Angels.
trend_watch.dans_take: Welcome back to the party, Bello, because we need that kind of stuff for the stretch run.
